_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY, taken 2026-11-03 from Anthropic's published first-party API list prices; verify every number against the vendor's current price list before relying on it. Prices are per million tokens. cache_write is the 5-minute cache write price (1.25x input); one-hour cache writes cost more and are not distinguished in the counts. Codex/OpenAI models are deliberately absent: add them from OpenAI's price list (cache_write 0 if the vendor does not charge for it). A key ending in * matches every model id starting with the rest. Used by ccd serve --usage-prices (docs/adr/0022); the interface shows the result as an estimate, never as spent.
